WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.

6. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

7. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.

8. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.

11. When learning Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

12. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wood working joints and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Preparation 3.4 Project Activity – Furniture Item 4.0. Related drawings  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

2. A — Information and Communication Technology

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.

4. B — CPU

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.

9. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.

15. (4 marks)
